theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (G : Eucl P → Eucl P) (ω : TestFormOn U m), IsRectifiableTriple U (m + 1) M θ ξ → Measurable G → ∃ g : Eucl P → ℝ, Measurable g ∧ Integrable g ((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M) ∧ (∀ x, G x = 0 → g x = 0) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), (G x ≠ 0 → g x = θ x * (ξ x).comp ((ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFinCLM ℝ (Eucl P) ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℝ (Eucl P) (Covector (Eucl P) m) (innerSL ℝ (‖G x‖⁻¹ • G x)))) ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x)) ∧ θ x * ξ x (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin ((innerSL ℝ (G x)).smulRight ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x))) = ‖G x‖ * g x
